title: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent in Power Systems
summary: China Southern Power Grid reports that its flow-control agent outperformed dispatchers in control evaluations. Energy and emissions benefits are not quantified.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Southern Power Grid reports that its flow-control agent outperformed dispatchers in control evaluations. Energy and emissions benefits are not quantified. Grid deployment described / product development. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Optimize power dispatch while maintaining transmission and stability constraints.
system: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent
developer: China Southern Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd.

ratings.reason: The deployed agent is reported to outperform human dispatchers in comprehensive control evaluations, supporting a control-capability improvement. The chapter does not quantify the gain.
More renewable energy and lower emissions are intended benefits; their extent is not measured.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent in Power Systems

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Real-time grid-state data and operational safety constraints

headline: An AI agent supports power-grid dispatch

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
